p4_b0.ocr: In December 2023, McKinsey & Company reported Revenue per consultant across various Consultant Types in the Professional & Business Services sector in INR, revealing that Senior Consultants generated a Revenue of $500M with a Year-over-Year Change of 10%, while Junior Consultants contributed $300M with a Year-over-Year Change of 15%.

p4_b1.ocr: The Total Revenue amounted to $800M, reflecting a 12% increase, constituting a Market Share of 25% in Consulting, with a Research segment accounting for 15% of the Total Market. The overall Revenue per Consultant was reported as $1,000M, indicating a Growth Rate of 12%. The Average Revenue per Consultant stood at $50M, with Senior Growth at 8% and Junior Growth at 9%.
